purpose: Independent human annotation of one immutable T070 candidate pair. Automation must not populate annotator identity, label, rationale, competence attestation, or disposition.
rules: One template instance represents exactly one annotator decision for one exact immutable pair.
Two competent independent annotations are required before adjudication where the frozen T070 workflow requires double annotation.
Do not expose acquisition stratum, generator intent, model prediction, other annotator decision, or adjudication outcome before the annotator submits.
A missing source-rights approval binding keeps the annotation ineligible for release evidence.
Blank or machine-populated human fields never count as human evidence.
